name.en-US: The Supplement to the Spiritual Combat

description.en-US: The Supplement (Aggiunta) that Scupoli added to the Spiritual Combat, in thirty-eight short chapters: the nature of Christian perfection, the necessity of the conflict, the three things the young soldier of Christ needs, and further counsels on the spiritual war, the passions, prayer and the examination of conscience. English translation of 1875; the Italian is not yet imported.
description.it: L’Aggiunta di Scupoli al Combattimento spirituale, in trentotto brevi capitoli. Traduzione inglese del 1875; l’originale italiano non è ancora importato.
description.pt-BR: O Suplemento (Aggiunta) de Scupoli ao Combate espiritual, em trinta e oito capítulos breves. Tradução inglesa de 1875.

en-US.translator: Anonymous (Library of Spiritual Works for English Catholics, London: Rivingtons)

sources.edition: The Spiritual Combat, a new translation, Library of Spiritual Works for English Catholics, London/Oxford/Cambridge: Rivingtons, 1875. English Wikisource transcription (proofread from scan index Spiritualcombat.djvu).
sources.description: The thirty-eight chapters of the Supplement with their rubrics. The series was Anglo-Catholic, but the Catholic content is kept. The Italian original of this piece (Venice 1770 and other collected editions) exists only as long-s OCR and is not imported.
sources.tierEvidence: Published 1875 by an anonymous translator: public domain in the US (before 1931).
